//: Port of this folder's denver.yml to devbox (https://www.jetify.com/devbox).
Written to spec and NOT executed -- devbox and nix are not installed in the
repo that produced this branch. See ../PORTING-devbox.md.
denver original: 'uv' -> 'conan'. A cross-compilation toolchain, no Docker.
This is where devbox is strongest of the five tools compared: nixpkgs has
the ARM bare-metal toolchain packaged and cached, so the half of this env
that costs denver a conan recipe costs devbox one line.
UNVERIFIED VERSION -- nixpkgs packages the toolchain as gcc-arm-embedded,
but pinning it to exactly 15.3 depends on some nixpkgs revision having
built that version, and devbox's @version syntax resolves against its own
search index. denver's conan/recipes/arm-none-eabi/15.3/ pins the upstream
ARM tarball and checksum directly, so it never depends on a third party
GAP (hard) -- pico-sdk is not in nixpkgs, and denver's recipe also *builds
picotool from source*. Neither has a devbox equivalent short of writing a
Nix derivation, which is the thing devbox exists to let you avoid. It
degrades to the shell script below.
